proof: For a fixed norm64 tail, norm128 points have core squared norm64 and distinct core products at most0. A unit Gram matrix G of m such core points has -1<=Gij<=0 off diagonal, so tr(G^2)<=2m using sum(Gij)>=0. Cauchy-Schwarz gives rank(G)>=m/2, while rank(G)<=24. Hence m<=48. The displayed alphabets are saturated. Deleting any outside points cannot raise this bound.
scope: Allows arbitrary real core bodies on each of the stated fixed tails and deletion of ANY incumbent points, but no new tail directions or other radii.
